predecessors.name: Spanish Empire
predecessors.text: the Ecuadorian coast from Esmeraldas to Tumbes: Guayas, Santa Elena, Manabí, most of Los Ríos, El Oro, Cañar and part of Esmeraldas

successors.name: Gran Colombia
successors.text: 'On July 31, 1822, the Free Province of Guayaquil declared its official annexation to' Gran Colombia

ledger.x: Late 1820: the municipalities of the coast join Guayaquil.
31 July 1822: Guayaquil is annexed to Gran Colombia.
July 1822: the free province ends in Gran Colombia.

wars.name: Guayaquil's independence and the Quito campaign
wars.outcome: Independence confirmed: the page says Guayaquil's emancipation was 'completed ... on May 24, 1822, in the Battle of Pichincha'; the province then joins Gran Colombia on 31 July 1822.

certainty.note: The page gives provinces by their modern names, no treaty or survey line; the southern end at Tumbes is approximate.
